newsitem.title: SPAIN: Angry Spanish olive farmers protest at EU plan.
newsitem.headline: Angry Spanish olive farmers protest at EU plan.

text.p: More than 50,000 Spaniards protested in Madrid on Saturday against a European Union proposal to alter the way olive oil production is subsidised.

"They want to ruin the olive industry which is our life in Andalucia," said olive grove farmer Francisco Ligero, who came up from his home in the southern Andalucian town of Malaga to participate in the demonstration.
"Demonstrations like this will help," Ligero told Reuters.

Under the current system, the Commission offers production subsidies based on production rates, but has proposed switching this to a system based on the number of olive trees in order to clamp down on fraud.

Spain complains that the new plan would cut vital subsidies to as low as 30 billion pesetas ($207.7 million) from around 100 billion now, crippling an industry that provides thousands of jobs in some of the economically weakest parts of the nation.
